title: Release change: version 0.1.0 and remove private (DEC-299)
description: The release change DEC-299 reserves: set @opum-ai/glyph to 0.1.0 and remove private, in one PR, nothing else. release.yml is workflow_dispatch only (no push or tag trigger) and its publish job additionally requires a v* tag ref, so merging this change cannot publish anything. No tag, npm publish, visibility flip, npm or GitHub setting, or Trusted Publisher is done by an agent; those are the operator's tier-3 steps, listed in order in GCLI-46's checklist and the operator checklist sent to the leader. Opus review (release and public-surface floor) before landing; promotion to main is the leader's.

acceptanceCriteria.text: package.json reads version 0.1.0 and has no private key (proof: the packaging test asserts both and the diff shows only those two lines)
tests that pinned 0.0.0 now read the version from package.json, so a future bump does not need a test edit (proof: the version tests in test/cli.test.ts derive from package.json and pass)
the packed tarball is named opum-ai-glyph-0.1.0.tgz and the Package gate passes with it (proof: the Package job green on the head; the gate output names the tarball)
merging cannot publish: release.yml has no push, tag or schedule trigger and the publish job requires a v* tag ref (proof: the workflow on: block read at the head, quoted in the PR)
no tag exists and nothing was published (proof: git ls-remote --tags origin empty and npm view @opum-ai/glyph returning not found, both read after the merge)
the change landed with an Opus review at the exact head (proof: review verdict recorded in the task notes)

implementationNotes: Landed in glyph-cli#99, squash 1d462b6 on dev (head e72e6ba; Opus review claude-opus-5-5 = APPROVE; CI Check, Docs, Package, Tracker integrity green). Evidence: package.json diff is only version 0.1.0 and the removed private key; test/packaging.test.ts asserts both; the CLI version tests read package.json; the Package job packed and gated the 0.1.0 tarball; release.yml on: is workflow_dispatch only and its publish job requires a v* tag ref, so the merge published nothing. After the merge: git ls-remote --tags origin returned no tags, and npm view @opum-ai/glyph returned E404 (not found). Non-blocking points from the reviewer, recorded verbatim in substance: (a) the reviewer read files and did not run the diff; (b) status was kept In Progress while the PR was open; (c) gap: check-package.mjs never runs --version, so no gate proves the bundled dist/glyph.js reports 0.1.0 and not the 0.0.0 fallback, filed as GCLI-50 (low, not started). Blocker for the tag, found by the reviewer: README.md ships in the tarball and still says the package is private and unpublished, so GCLI-49 (README for the published package) must land before any v0.1.0 tag, and the tag must name a commit that contains it. The operator tier-3 steps (bootstrap or first publish, visibility flip, release environment and v* tag protection, Trusted Publisher, tag, dispatches) are untouched and unrelayed.
finalSummary: glyph 0.1.0 release change: version set and private removed (package.json only) plus tests that read the version. Merged to dev without publishing anything; Opus review APPROVE at the exact head; the README blocker and the --version gate gap are tracked as GCLI-49 and GCLI-50.
